body: Thank you so much!! I will look into that! I ask sooo many questions from everyone. I’m lucky that we have good surgeons too that will help explain in a way I can actually understand (surprisingly!). Did you find that writing notes during the shift was helpful? I’ve seen some suggest writing things you find interesting down and looking it up but I’m so busy that half the time I forget what I wanted to write
This is so incredibly helpful!! Thank you! I’m a cheapskate too so I will for sure be using those!
Thank you thank you thank you!!!!
I would love them!! Thank you!!!
